title: The member fetch leaves a delivered build store unmerged
foundBy: session agent, reviewing how local builds reach campaign members (tasks/pin-on-local-builds.md, section 8)

evidence.verified: TestFetchTakesABuildStoreIn passes under `go test ./cmd/cs-campaign-member/ -count=1`. GitHub CI's `ci` passed on 8fd7503, once a macOS smoke job was run again: podman there had refused to start a container.

resolution: A member fetch of the repository `CS_BUILD_STORE` names takes the teammate's builds into the orchestrator's clone at once (SPEC R119a). That is a fast forward where it took in nothing since, and a merge otherwise. MANUAL.md shows how to give a campaign a shared store.
details: A campaign's build store is a repository its members hold a clone of, which the orchestrator carries like a project repository (DSH-029). `cs-campaign-member fetch` leaves what it fetched on a remote-tracking ref. So the orchestrator's own store does not see a member's new builds until somebody merges them by hand, and every store push waits on that.
